glance.headline: Google turns off Search for schools skipping AI
glance.teaser: Schools rejecting AI lose Search access
glance.summary: Google is completely turning off Google Search, Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Gemini in Classroom for K-12 student accounts in schools that reject its AI features.
glance.why: Schools rejecting AI features will lose access to Google Search for K-12 student accounts.

explain.kid: Google is turning off Google Search and Gemini for student accounts if their school decides not to use Google AI tools.
explain.pm: Google is revoking Google Search access for K-12 student accounts in schools that reject Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Gemini in Classroom features.
explain.engineer: Schools opting out of Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Gemini in Classroom will have Google Search access entirely disabled across all K-12 student accounts.

office_blend.headline: Circle K speeds up incident triage using Bedrock
office_blend.summary: Circle K's DevOps team reduced incident triage times from 45-60 minutes down to under 15 minutes by building an agentic triage system on Amazon Bedrock.

office_blend.headline: Gen Digital creates AI news engine for Norton
office_blend.summary: Gen Digital built Norton Revamp's AI-curated News Engine using Web Search on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to deliver real-time content suggestions with zero data egress.

still_roasting.summary: OpenAI plans to pilot its "Grid Protectors Program" at an upcoming Georgia data center to free up power during emergencies.

Google expanded its Dreambeans AI experiment to support 13 Indian languages for personal story generation.
OpenAI is quietly renaming its data centers as "compute campuses" to help defuse public opposition.

stories.label: New model
stories.headline: Canva Brush writes code to edit design files
stories.summary: Canva introduced Canva Brush, a vision-language model that edits graphic design files by writing code rather than generating images.

stories.label: Infrastructure update
stories.headline: OpenAI builds custom Git backend for monorepo
stories.summary: OpenAI detailed how it developed a custom Git backend for its monorepo to support its growing developer base.

concept.explanation: A type of AI model, such as Canva Brush, designed for visual tasks that writes code to edit graphic designs instead of generating images directly.

long_read.headline: The Pulse: Anthropic kills the coding interview
long_read.summary: The newsletter reports that AI has rendered Leetcode-style coding interviews pointless, prompting Anthropic to remove them from its developer hiring loop.
